terms: ## Conversational Texture The user asked to do two things: (1) commit ClawCreek story metadata to close the Bug 3 metadata-loss risk (done, commit a8050da), and (2) open this framework story to fix Bug 1/1a. This is the framework half. Scope must stay on the reported failures, not a repo-wide git rewrite.

## Key Insights An id-independent resolver already exists and is proven: resolveProjectGitRoot(metadataRoot, configuredGitRoot) in packages/main/src/core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts (added/used by B-198c doctor + advisory). The fix is to route the main-branch-relative git read ops through it instead of cwd/root. Confirmed call sites: core/cluster-sync.ts (git log main..HEAD), the concept CLI gate (git diff main...HEAD), and story_discard. session.ts git log and test-story.ts git diff are the same pattern but lower priority.

## Solution Tradeoffs Option A (chosen-leaning): route the reported commands (concept gate, cluster-sync, story_discard) through resolveProjectGitRoot with a fallback to metadataRoot for plain repos, plus a tiny shared git-cwd helper. Minimal, targeted, mirrors B-4e06, keeps plain-repo behavior byte-identical. Option B: a sweeping all-git-invocations-use-resolved-gitRoot refactor — broader blast radius, higher regression risk, scope creep. Reject B per the do-not-over-engineer steer.

## Trigger Event 2026-06-15: A re-validation report on Lattice 0.3.5 confirmed Bug 1/1a still reproduce. Empirically re-confirmed in ClawCreek: lattice validate --concept prints warning: Not a git repository / [concept] warn: git diff failed (main...HEAD), and the finding cluster-sync skips with not a git repository. Root cause is the same class as B-4e06 (which fixed worktree bootstrap to honor a configured gitRoot) but these read-side commands were never routed through the resolved gitRoot.

Add a small shared helper resolving the git cwd for main-relative read ops
Bug 1a: story_discard uses the same metadataRoot git path. Implementer must locate its git invocation(s) and route them through the shared helper.

core/cluster-sync.ts syncClusterResolves runs git log main..HEAD; on wrapper-root it currently skips with not a git repository. Run it in the resolved git cwd so Resolves: CL-xxx auto-resolve works on wrapper-root projects.

Fixture with gitRoot != metadataRoot: concept/cluster-sync/discard now resolve git in the gitRoot (no false Not a git repository); plain-repo (metadataRoot==gitRoot) path unchanged. Test at function level, not via the global lattice binary.

On wrapper-root projects (configured gitRoot points at a subdir; metadataRoot is not a git repo), several read-side commands run git from cwd/metadataRoot instead of the resolved gitRoot and fail with Not a git repository. Confirmed reproductions (2026-06-15 re-validation): lattice validate --concept runs git diff main...HEAD and warns Not a git repository (concept reviewer skipped); the finding cluster-sync runs git log main..HEAD and skips with not a git repository; story_discard goes through the same metadataRoot git path (Bug 1a). This is the same root-cause class as B-4e06, which fixed worktree bootstrap to honor the configured gitRoot but never routed these read-side commands through it. Fix: resolve the configured gitRoot (reuse the existing resolveProjectGitRoot in core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts) and run these git invocations there, falling back to metadataRoot for plain repos (byte-identical). Scope to the reported commands; do NOT do a repo-wide git refactor.

Reuse resolveProjectGitRoot(metadataRoot, config.gitRoot) from core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts; return the resolved gitRoot when configured + valid, else fall back to metadataRoot/cwd. Plain repos (no configured gitRoot, or metadataRoot==gitRoot) must behave byte-identically. Never throw.
Route main-relative git read commands through the resolved gitRoot (wrapper-root fix)
Route story_discard git operations through the resolved git cwd
Route the concept CLI gate git diff through the resolved git cwd
Route the finding cluster-sync git log through the resolved git cwd
Tests: wrapper-root fixture where these commands run git successfully; plain repo unchanged
